svg.title: SpielSpot product showcase
svg.desc: Actual SpielSpot homepage and Berlin map interface, arranged as angled panels on a forest-green background. Map data copyright OpenStreetMap contributors.
svg.metadata: Source: https://spielspot.netlify.app/ and https://spielspot.netlify.app/playgrounds, captured October 19, 2026. Artwork uses real product screenshots. Map attribution: https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright. Composition inspired by the Appwrite product-cover approach; no Appwrite assets copied.
